inline:The target formulates the relation as 'integrates' (a compatibility/integration relation) yet defines its refutation condition as 'Variance Floor is purely individual cognitive effect rather than a collective panel effect' — that refutes the dependence of the effect on the panel, not the integration of the two floors.
The problem asks for a substantive relation naming its kind and stating what refutes it. The target picks integration but its 'refuted if' negates the source attribution of one endpoint, not the integration itself; integration is refuted if the mechanisms conflict or cannot be combined, not merely if one factor has an individual-level cause. So the stated refutation does not correspond to the named relation kind; at most it establishes a conditional dependence (panel-level iff non-individual), not integration.
